title: No-void-fall
description: Just a simple plugin for your server, that prevents falling players into void, instead it teleports you to spawn. You can customize message of teleportation and dimensions, where will it work.
body: Just a simple plugin for your server, that prevents faling players into void, instead it teleports you to spawn and it has a customizable message of teleporting. Supports Java 1.20.5+ paper servers :)
